name: Music under
oneliner: Your own track from assets/music, ducked under your voice.
description: A song from your music folder, looped to length and dipped about 22 dB whenever you talk.
prompt: Sound pass with music. Needs a track in assets/music/ (*.mp3); if there is none, skip the card and ask once for a royalty-free track. Run it on the finished picture (after captions, before QA): python3 scripts/rr.py run -- python3 engines/sound.py "$W/captioned.mp4" --out "$W/sound.mp4" --edl "$W/edl.json" --captions "$W/draft.words.json" --preset clean --music "<main folder>/assets/music/<track>.mp3". The track is looped or trimmed to the video, sidechain-ducked under the voice to about -22 dB (louder in the gaps), faded in over 0.5 s and out over 1.5 s; voice polish, room-tone bed and short whooshes on cuts as in S1. Ends at -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP, video stream copied. This replaces the separate music step: do NOT also mix music with rr.py duck-filter, never use a track the user did not supply, and do NOT run a second S card.
